defects.title: Real special-certificate builder accepts impossible issue, expiry and check dates
defects.trigger: A correctly typed/same-episode/exact-hash certificate uses a nonexistent calendar date that JavaScript Date normalizes. No upstream validator checks calendar components before the gate.
defects.actualCaller: buildUtahSpecialCertificate({stageInput}) -> source/registry/census exactness checks -> specialCertificateStageGate(stageInput) -> assert ALLOW_STAGE_2 -> writeJson(source-receipt.json). Filesystem barrier intercepts the first mkdir before mutation; no PDF/render call occurs.
defects.expected: Refuse impossible recorded calendar dates before ALLOW_STAGE_2; dates cannot establish certificate validity if the stated day does not exist.
defects.measurement: All 3 impossible-date real-wrapper calls cross the gate; valid positive control crosses too. Missing certificate, missing expected hash and unparseable date controls refuse first. Every family file hash, size,mtime andctime unchanged.
defects.smallestCompleteCorrection: Validate issuedAt, expiresAt and asOf as actual calendar dates before converting or comparing them; reject date rollover and preserve supported valid Date objects/date/timestamp inputs, current UTC default, exactepisode/hash checks and180 day bound. Keep the current PDF bytes and their33 page receipt. Add narrow refusal/positive tests and rerun existing read-only checks; no new PDF/raster evidence required for unchanged bytes.
defects.scopeLimit: Proves the real exported review-builder gate accepts invalid dates. It does not claim any participant runtime route is open or any current fixture date is invalid.

nonblockingObservations.title: Unknownbranch helper plans a conviction case number
nonblockingObservations.fact: Five direct textPlans hook inputs with absent/null/empty/unknown/boolean branch plan1001EX field p2-y407.50-x162.00 despite no branch selection. addPetitionPlans has an else fallback at1158.
nonblockingObservations.callerBoundary: runUtahCompletenessRepair3321–3325 creates explicit without_conviction/with_conviction facts for every actual call. No caller accepts participant recordedFacts. This cannot alter the current artifacts and is not counted as a reachable failure.
nonblockingObservations.futureCorrection: If this planner is later used with external facts, make the conviction text arm require branch === with_conviction or reject unknown branch upstream.
